contract: Ordered native runtime values through the existing NativeObservation and strict source decoder.
compared: Every case: projected complete runtime value, including missing/null/non-finite values and opaque function identity.
Every case: outcome.returned; successful outcome.result in full; failed outcome.error name, message, every own property other than the already source-excluded stack, and property order.
Every case: every events entry in order, its complete keys and values; projection input, hash input, verifier hash/password arguments and sameHash; callback mutation stored Account rows.
Every case: functions[*].identity in first-observation order and errorFunctions (empty in all 18 cases).
Every case: all stored user/session/account/verification/twoFactor rows, row order, every field, own-undefined values, Date values, and field order.
Every runtime object and array: source own-key and descriptor order validated by the strict shared decoder; runtime key order and array length compared by assert_replay.

notCompared.reason: Rust functions do not expose JavaScript source reflection. All fields remain unchanged in the frozen source fixture.

Function snapshots cross the explicitly selected opaque function boundary. Actual function identity and verifier sameHash are compared; JavaScript function own descriptors and prototype graphs are not modeled.
The existing runtime observer compares values and order; general object allocation labels are not exposed. The 18-case source contains no shared-reference snapshot outside function metadata.
FieldObject exposes enumerable state, not JavaScript writable/configurable flags. These source descriptor flags remain preserved.

harnessMutationBoundary: The callback uses the real Memory Store update for provider changes and primary-key/password replacement. This produces the complete source-observed Account state and preserves the selected pre-callback Account ID. Raw external JavaScript array splice identity itself is not asserted.
verification: Rust CI pending; source fixture already frozen from successful CI.
